Name: ACCOUNT_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the name texts and emblem of a character account (an AC and its pilot), used in the HUD, menus and conversations.

Fields.Name: Name Text ID
Fields.Description:
Base text ID from the NPC character texts. Register the texts at these offsets from it:
+0 FE AC name
+1 FE pilot name
+2 Menu AC name
+3 Menu pilot name / conversation speaker name
+4 AC name / pilot name

Fields.Name: Emblem Decal ID
Fields.Description: ID of the emblem image. Refers to the menu decal thumbnails (SB_DecalThumbnails.layout).
